comment: Schwartz is awesome, I absolutely recommend him. I was dreading taking philosophy (had to for my major) but he turned what could have been a deadly boring subject into a fun class. Bit of a spazz but in a good way. Does not give many assignments. He's the best!

He's the man. Put more colloquially, he is "that dude." I loved my experience with him. He is an exceptionally fair grader, and skilled communicator. I always looked forward to his class. He has a real knack for connecting with students. This IS the path to fulfill the symbolic logic requirement without have to gnash your teeth in a calculus course

Schwartz is chill, funny, and pretty good at this philosophy thing. Symbolic Logic is your alternative to Precal. Some will be baffled by the squiggly letters. Other will enjoy the problems, which are basically logic puzzles. Nice course structure, slowly establishing the rules. Schwartz can get off track, but he's also a very generous grader.
